input.story: Bhai maine 8 October 2026 ko UPI se 15000 bheje, paise account se kat gaye par receiver ko nahi mile. Bank ko complaint ki, 3 hafte ho gaye koi jawab nahi. Kya karun?

output.masked_story: Bhai maine 8 October 2026 ko UPI se 15000 bheje, paise account se kat gaye par receiver ko nahi mile. Bank ko complaint ki, 3 hafte ho gaye koi jawab nahi. Kya karun?

case.summary: The user sent a UPI payment of 15000 on 8 October 2026, the amount was deducted from their account but the receiver did not get it. They lodged a complaint with the bank, but after three weeks there has been no response.
case.user_goal: Get the transferred amount credited to the receiver or refunded to the sender.

timeline.event: Sent 15000 via UPI; amount deducted from sender's account
timeline.proof: bank statement or UPI transaction receipt

timeline.event: No response from bank after filing complaint

evidence_missing: complaint reference number or acknowledgment from bank
any communication from the receiver confirming non-receipt
follow_up_questions: Aap kis state aur city mein rehte hain?
Bank ko complaint karte waqt aapko koi reference number ya complaint ID mili thi?
Kya aapke paas transaction ka screenshot ya UPI receipt hai?
Receiver ne aapko koi reply ya confirmation diya hai?

notes: Not enough numbers to calculate. Tell me the amounts involved.
Interest on delayed money may be claimable; the rate is for a lawyer/court to decide, so we don't add it here.

assessment.where_you_stand: Aap ek consumer hain kyunki aapne UPI ke through service (payment) li. Bank ne aapka paisa deduct kar diya lekin receiver ko nahi mila, isliye service mein deficiency hai [KB:cpa_consumer_def]. Aapke paas transaction receipt aur bank statement hai – ye strong proof hain. Lekin aapke paas bank ka complaint reference ya receiver ka non‑receipt confirmation nahi hai, jo aapke case ko thoda weak bana sakta hai. Abhi tak 2‑year limitation period ka koi issue nahi hai [KB:cpa_limitation].

options.title: RBI Ombudsman [KB:rbi_ios_2026] ko complain karein
options.what_to_do: Bank ki grievance ko likhit roop mein (email/letter) bhejein, complaint reference ya acknowledgement ka screenshot lein. 30 din ke andar reply na milne par RBI Ombudsman [KB:rbi_ios_2026] portal (cms.rbi.org.in) par free complaint file karein. Attach transaction receipt, bank statement, aur bank se milne wali koi bhi communication.
needs: bank ke complaint ka acknowledgement (if any)

options.title: Bank ke grievance officer ko likhit complaint
options.what_to_do: Bank ki website ya app par grievance officer ka contact dhundein (usually 48‑hour acknowledgement hota hai). Apni UPI receipt aur statement attach karte hue ek formal email/letter bhejein, reference number maangein. 1 month ke andar response ka demand karein.

options.title: National Consumer Helpline [KB:forum_nch] (NCH) se madad lein
options.what_to_do: 1915 par call karein ya consumerhelpline.gov.in par online complaint file karein. Unko sabhi documents (receipt, statement, bank ke saath ki hui baatein) bhejein. NCH aapke liye bank ko pressure mein la sakta hai aur refund ya credit ki request ko aage badha sakta hai.

options.title: District Consumer Commission me complaint file karein
options.what_to_do: e‑Jagriti portal (e‑Jagriti) par login karke consumer complaint file karein. Value Rs 15,000 hone ki wajah se District Commission me jaayega, filing fee nil hai [KB:cpa_fee_nil_5lakh]. Sabhi documents (receipt, bank statement, grievance officer ka response ya uska na hona) upload karein.

proof_tips: Bank ko email/letter bhejne ke baad uska delivery receipt ya read receipt lein.
UPI app se transaction ka screenshot lein jisme date, amount, aur status 'Failed/Refund Pending' dikh raha ho.
Receiver se likhit confirmation (WhatsApp ya email) maangein ki unhe paise receive nahi hue.
what_i_dont_know: Bank ka exact grievance officer ka contact detail
Receiver ka exact response ya proof ki unhone paise receive nahi kiye
assessment.needs_lawyer_reason: Abhi tak aapke paas simple pre‑litigation steps hain (bank grievance, RBI Ombudsman [KB:rbi_ios_2026], NCH). Lawyer ki zaroorat tab hogi jab in sabka koi fayda na ho ya aapko District Commission me formal hearing attend karni pade.
assessment.reply: Aapka paisa UPI se deduct ho gaya lekin receiver ko nahi mila, isliye service mein deficiency hai [KB:cpa_consumer_def]. Aapke paas transaction receipt aur bank statement hai – ye strong proof hain, lekin bank ka complaint reference ya receiver ka confirmation abhi missing hai. Sabse pehle, bank ke grievance officer ko likhit complaint bhejein aur 48 ghante ke acknowledgement ka demand karein [KB:ecom_grievance_officer]. Agar 30 din mein koi reply nahi milta, to RBI Ombudsman portal par free complaint file karein [KB:rbi_ios_2026]. Saath hi, National Consumer Helpline (1915) se bhi madad le sakte hain, wo bank ko pressure mein la sakte hain [KB:forum_nch]. Agar in steps se solution nahi milta, to aap e‑Jagriti portal se District Consumer Commission me nil filing fee ke saath complaint file kar sakte hain [KB:cpa_fee_nil_5lakh]. Kya aapke paas bank se koi acknowledgement ya reference number hai?
